title: HireLogiX
subtitle: Gmail-Powered Job Search Tracking & Insights
description: HireLogix connects to Gmail and turns scattered hiring emails into a structured view of the user's job search. It identifies applications, assessments, interviews, offers, and rejections, filters irrelevant and sensitive emails, and uses Google Gemini to extract the company, role, and application stage. Related emails are combined into one application and presented through a visual dashboard with application statistics, pipeline tracking, timelines, and job-search insights.
highlights: Processes Gmail hiring emails into structured applications while filtering banking, OTP, personal, promotional, and job-alert emails
Visual dashboard with application statistics, filterable applications, Kanban pipeline, recent updates, and detailed application records
Combines related hiring emails into one application with a chronological timeline and continuously updated application status

title: TripBill
subtitle: Digital Billing for Indian Travel & Cab Operations
description: TripBill is a browser-based billing application built for Indian travel and cab operators. It provides a Single Trip Sheet for corporate, airport, outstation, and hourly bookings, along with a Multi-Trip Cash Bill for recording multiple daily duties. Trip costs are calculated in real time and exported as high-resolution printable PDFs directly from the browser.
highlights: Two travel billing workflows: A4 landscape Single Trip Sheets and portrait Multi-Trip Cash Bills with dynamic duty entries
Real-time calculations for kilometres, hours, tolls, parking, driver bata, night charges, advances, balances, and totals
High-resolution PDF generation directly in the browser with Indian Rupee localization and print-ready layouts

title: AK Tours & Travels
subtitle: Bengaluru Cab Booking & Travel Platform
description: A React-based cab booking platform built for Bengaluru and Karnataka travel, allowing customers to book airport transfers, city rentals, outstation trips, and corporate rides through a single interactive booking experience. It includes real-time fare calculation, vehicle selection, Karnataka tour packages, transparent fare breakdowns, and WhatsApp-based booking requests.
highlights: Interactive booking engine supporting BLR airport transfers, hourly rentals, Karnataka outstation trips, and corporate bookings
Real-time fare calculation with vehicle selection, trip duration, included kilometres, driver charges, and transparent cost breakdowns
WhatsApp booking dispatch with structured trip details, plus vehicle fleet browsing and curated Karnataka tour packages

title: FindIt
subtitle: Campus Lost & Found Recovery Platform
description: FindIt is a campus-focused lost-and-found platform that helps students and faculty recover misplaced belongings through structured search and reporting. Users can search reported found items by category, campus location, and date, or quickly report something they found with photos and verified contact details. The platform replaces scattered group messages with searchable records and a safer recovery workflow.
highlights: Searches found items using campus zone, category, item name, date, and optional time filters
Quick found-item reporting with image upload, 10-digit contact validation, descriptions, and category selection
JWT-protected API with PostgreSQL, authenticated contact information, and campus-specific recovery safeguards

title: Weather App
subtitle: Real-Time Weather Forecasting Application
description: A responsive weather application that fetches current weather conditions and forecasts for a requested location through the OpenWeather API, with server-side handling for invalid locations and API failures.
highlights: Integrates Django with the OpenWeather REST API
Handles invalid locations and API failures on the server
Responsive weather interface deployed on Render

title: To-Do App
subtitle: Simple Task Management Application
description: A lightweight React task management application for creating, organizing, filtering, and completing everyday tasks through a simple responsive interface.
highlights: Create, update, complete, and filter tasks through a responsive React interface
Separate completed and pending task views for quick task management
Deployed as a lightweight web application on Vercel
